title: GeoCoV19: A Dataset of Hundreds of Millions of Multilingual COVID-19 Tweets with Location Information
reasoning: The paper focuses on presenting a large-scale, geolocated Twitter dataset related to the COVID-19 pandemic. It discusses technical methods for data collection and geolocation inference, and suggests research applications in public health, such as disease surveillance and tracking misinformation. There is no section or component dedicated to the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
